razonamiento: The architecture diagram displays a batch pipeline (top) and a real-time streaming pipeline (bottom) integrating Expedia Group data into Salesforce. In the batch path, Expedia Group feeds an ingestion S3 data lake, which splits into EC2 (handling Parquet and custom transformations) and Glue ETL; both output to an S3 bucket storing data in CSV format. In the real-time path, Kafka events from Expedia Group are consumed by Kafka consumers on ECS, written to Aurora for aggregation/sorting, processed by Lambda, buffered into SQS, and finally pushed to Salesforce.
nombre: Expedia Group Batch and Real-Time Integration to Salesforce
